```{r function}
# process_air_data()
# Function Purpose: 
  # Read in and clean one year of EPA air quality data from 
  #the RDU airport monitor

# Each Argument:
  # file_path = file path to each year's CSV file
  # o3_units = the units for ozone levels either ppm or ppb

# Function Returns:
  # a data frame with:
  # row = each day
  # columns = date, co, pm25, o3

clean_data <- function(file_path, o3_units = "ppm") {

# Check that o3_units is a valid option
  
  if (!(o3_units %in% c("ppm", "ppb"))) {
    stop("o3_units must be either 'ppm' or 'ppb'")
  }

# Read in the data
  
dat <- read.csv(file_path)

# Keep the date and the 3 pollutant columns (no units columns needed)

dat <- dat[, c(1, 2, 4, 6)]
names(dat) <- c("date", "co", "pm25", "o3")

# Format the date variable

dat$date <- as.Date(dat$date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")

# Remove duplicate rows 

dat <- unique(dat)

# Set negative values to 0

  for (i in 2:ncol(dat)) {
    dat[!is.na(dat[, i]) & dat[, i] < 0, i] <- 0
  }

# Calculate the daily average for days with multiple measurements 

dat <- dat %>%
    group_by(date) %>%
    summarize(
      co   = ifelse(all(is.na(co)),   NA, mean(co,   na.rm = TRUE)),
      pm25 = ifelse(all(is.na(pm25)), NA, mean(pm25, na.rm = TRUE)),
      o3   = ifelse(all(is.na(o3)),   NA, mean(o3,   na.rm = TRUE))
    )


# Convert ozone to ppb if requested

  if (o3_units == "ppb") {
    dat$o3 <- dat$o3 * 1000
  }

  return(dat)
}
```

```{r combine}
# Run the function on each year and add a year variable
aq18 <- clean_data(file_path = "data/AQ_2018.csv")
aq18$year <- 2018

aq19 <- clean_data(file_path = "data/AQ_2019.csv")
aq19$year <- 2019

aq20 <- clean_data(file_path = "data/AQ_2020.csv")
aq20$year <- 2020

# Stack the three years into one dataset
air_quality <- rbind(aq18, aq19, aq20)
```
